title: myCHEF vs Chef Maison: which is better in 2026
body_html:
Choose myCHEF if you want a vetted chef and a planned menu for a home dinner, weekly meal prep or a catered event in Dubai, with the process spelled out before you book. Choose Chef Maison if a quote you have already received from them fits your date, menu and guest count better. This 2026 comparison of myCHEF vs Chef Maison sets out how to judge the two, and where the public record on Chef Maison stops.

TL;DR
  • myCHEF is a private chef and catering service in Dubai with vetted chefs and a halal-first standard.
  • Chef Maison's inclusions, staffing and terms are not covered here. Confirm them in writing before you book.
  • For a like-for-like comparison, request the same brief from both and compare the written quotes.
  • Choose myCHEF for a single brief covering home meals, meal prep, dinner parties and events.

Why this comparison matters in 2026

Private chef bookings in Dubai are decided on trust: who is cooking in your kitchen, what is included, and what the final invoice looks like. Two services can look identical on an Instagram grid and behave very differently on the day.

This page is written by myCHEF, so read it with that in mind. Everything stated about myCHEF comes from the company's own service description. Nothing is stated about Chef Maison that could not be checked by you directly, because inventing a competitor's terms helps nobody. If you want a wider field, the Chef Maison alternatives guide lists other options.

myCHEF is stronger on process you can verify

myCHEF describes its model in concrete terms: a chef for your kitchen, catering for your event. Chefs are vetted and scored, menus are designed around the client, and the kitchen is left exactly as it was found.

That matters because the risk in private cheffing is not the food on a good night. It is the unknowns: who turns up, what was agreed, and what state the kitchen is in at 11pm. A service that states its process gives you something to hold it to.

Verdict: myCHEF is the safer pick if you want the process stated up front.

Chef Maison: what to check before you book

The public information used for this page does not establish Chef Maison's chef selection, pricing structure, staffing model or event capacity. Rather than guess, treat the following as a checklist.

  • Who cooks: Ask for the chef's name, background and experience with your cuisine before the date.
  • Menu: Ask whether you get a designed menu or choose from a set list.
  • Inclusions: Ask about groceries, service staff, equipment, plating and clean-up.
  • Dietary needs: Ask how halal sourcing, allergies and cross-contact are handled.
  • Terms: Ask about deposits, cancellation and what happens if the chef is unavailable.

If Chef Maison answers all five clearly and in writing, it is a serious option. If any answer is vague, you have your decision.

Dietary standards: myCHEF states its position

myCHEF works halal-first. For households and corporate hosts in the UAE, that removes one of the most common points of friction at the planning stage. For a wider view of the market, the best halal catering companies in Dubai guide compares the field.

For Chef Maison, this is a question to put in writing, not assume.

Verdict: myCHEF is the clearer answer on halal. Chef Maison is unconfirmed.

Range of services

myCHEF covers home-cooked meals, weekly meal prep, dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations. One relationship can handle a Tuesday family dinner and a 100-guest event later in the year.

If you only need one dinner, range matters less. Both services may suit a single evening. The gap shows when your needs repeat or scale.

Verdict: a tie for a one-off dinner; myCHEF has the wider stated range for repeat and scaled bookings.

Pricing: compare models, not headline figures

myCHEF quotes to the brief: guest count, menu, service style and location all move the number. Published prices go stale, so this page does not quote any. For a breakdown of what drives cost, read how much a private chef costs in Dubai.

The useful comparison is structural:

  • Fixed packages are predictable but may not fit an unusual brief.
  • Quoted-to-brief pricing fits your event but requires you to be specific about it.

Send both services the same brief: date, area, guest count, dietary needs and service style. Compare the written quotes line by line, including what is excluded.

Verdict: no winner without two quotes on the same brief.

Reliability and reply times

myCHEF is built around typical reply times and a defined booking process. The practical test with any provider is the same: how quickly and how specifically do they respond to your brief? A fast reply with no menu detail is worse than a slightly slower reply with a proposed menu and named inclusions.

Verdict: judge both on the quality of the first reply.
